novel_features.name: Quota status + dry-run plan
novel_features.description: See exactly how many of your 25/day Alpha Vantage calls you have left, and preview what a command would burn before running it.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local quota_log table written by the API client. Every other wrapper silently fails on the 200-with-Note rate-limit shape (RomelTorres #125, finance-quote #130, TradingAgents #305).
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before any deep-dive or watchlist sweep — burning your 25/day in one fan-out leaves the rest of the session blind. The CLI tracks every call locally, so agents can plan with confidence.

novel_features.name: News sweep with ticker_sentiment preserved
novel_features.description: Pull NEWS_SENTIMENT for a watchlist in one command; persist articles AND the per-ticker sentiment array every other wrapper drops.
novel_features.rationale: Every existing wrapper discards the ticker_sentiment[] array (per-article, per-ticker relevance + sentiment_score) which is the highest-information field in Alpha Vantage's entire API. We persist it to SQLite and FTS5-index titles + summaries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When users ask 'which of my watchlist tickers has the strongest negative swing this week,' this is the only tool that can answer locally — without re-burning quota or losing the per-ticker breakdown.

novel_features.name: Sentiment timeline for a ticker
novel_features.description: Day-by-day mean sentiment + article count for a ticker, computed from local data with zero API calls.
novel_features.rationale: Pure SQL aggregation over the local ticker_sentiment table. Reconstructs a sentiment timeline that no single AV call gives.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in /stock-deep-dive to answer 'how has sentiment evolved for this ticker' without burning a single API call on already-pulled data.

novel_features.name: FTS5 news search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across all locally pulled news articles with boolean AND/OR, prefix matching, ranked results.
novel_features.rationale: SQLite FTS5 virtual table over articles.title + summary + topics. Joins back to ticker_sentiment for context. No re-fetch needed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find the article that drove a sentiment spike weeks later without burning any quota. Especially useful for research and journalism workflows.

novel_features.name: Pre-earnings briefing
novel_features.description: One-shot pre-earnings card: upcoming earnings date, recent earnings-topic news, last call transcript highlights, current quote.
novel_features.rationale: Orchestrates EARNINGS_CALENDAR + EARNINGS + NEWS_SENTIMENT(topic=earnings, ticker filter) + GLOBAL_QUOTE + EARNINGS_CALL_TRANSCRIPT in one command. Uses local cache where fresh.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Replaces 5 separate API calls + manual joining with one query. Ideal pre-print research for portfolio decisions.

novel_features.name: Movers + sentiment overlay
novel_features.description: Today's top gainers/losers with each ticker's 7d sentiment z-score from the local store.
novel_features.rationale: TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS API call LEFT JOIN local ticker_sentiment aggregated per ticker. Reveals whether moves are sentiment-driven or sentiment-free.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pre-market intel: distinguish 'top gainer with strong recent positive sentiment' from 'top gainer with negative sentiment' (potential reversal).

novel_features.name: Macro snapshot
novel_features.description: Current CPI, Fed Funds Rate, Treasury Yield curve, Unemployment, Nonfarm Payroll in one card.
novel_features.rationale: Joins 5 economic-indicator endpoints with indicator-natural TTL caching (CPI monthly, etc.) so daily reruns cost 0 API calls after first.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Daily macro context for /market-pulse in two API calls or fewer. Saves quota for ticker-level work.

novel_features.name: Watchlist sentiment with delta
novel_features.description: Per-ticker mean sentiment for a named watchlist, with delta-since-last-scan.
novel_features.rationale: Named persisted watchlists × ticker_sentiment history. Reads prior scan timestamp from sync_log; reports change for each ticker.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Weekly Sunday-night ritual: 'which of my 12 names shifted sentiment most this week' in one read.

novel_features.name: Compound screen
novel_features.description: Filter tickers by multi-predicate (min sentiment, earnings within N days, recent insider net-buy) across local tables.
novel_features.rationale: Multi-predicate SQL across local ticker_sentiment (aggregated) + earnings_calendar + insider_transactions. No single API call expresses this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Surface 'high-conviction setups' in a watchlist without external screeners. Uses only local data after sync.

novel_features.name: Daily pulse bundle
novel_features.description: Designed for /market-pulse: top movers + macro snapshot + watchlist sentiment delta in <=2 API calls.
novel_features.rationale: Explicit quota-aware orchestration: TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS (1 call cached daily) + macro snapshot (0 calls after first) + incremental watchlist news sync. Drops a full /market-pulse run from 10+ calls to <=2.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run /market-pulse every weekday morning without exhausting the 25/day quota by lunch. The quota strategy IS the feature.

novel_features.name: Sync backbone
novel_features.description: Pull-once-query-many: hydrate the local store with news, movers, or earnings calendar; incremental cursor avoids re-fetching.
novel_features.rationale: Incremental cursor (time_published for news, date for movers, quarter for fundamentals) stored in sync_log. Every other transcendence row depends on this existing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One burn of N calls hydrates the local store; the next 100 reads cost zero quota. The backbone for every other novel feature.

narrative.headline: Every Alpha Vantage function, plus a local SQLite cache and quota-aware planning no other AV tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps all 106 Alpha Vantage functions (stocks, news sentiment, fundamentals, FX, crypto, commodities, economics, 45 technical indicators) and adds the local store + cross-call workflows wrappers cannot. The 25/day free-tier quota is the design constraint, not an afterthought: every call logs to local quota_log, `quota plan` previews call-cost before execution, and `pulse us` hydrates a full daily snapshot in two API calls or fewer.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set `ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY` (or alias `ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY`) in your env. Free key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key. Free tier is 25 requests/day, but the CLI is built around that: one good `sync news` burn hydrates the local store and the next 100 reads cost zero quota. Use `doctor` to verify the key works and see remaining budget.

quickstart.comment: Confirm your API key works and see how many of today's 25 calls you've used.

quickstart.command: alphavantage-pp-cli quota plan news sweep --tickers NVDA,AAPL,MSFT
quickstart.comment: Preview a command's quota cost BEFORE running it — critical on the free tier.
Pull NEWS_SENTIMENT for 3 tickers in one shot. Articles + ticker_sentiment[] arrays land in local SQLite.
Now query the local store for 30-day sentiment trend. Zero API cost.
FTS5 search across pulled articles. Still zero API cost.
Today's top gainers with their 7d sentiment z-score from local data.

troubleshoots.fix: You hit the 25/day cap. Run `alphavantage-pp-cli quota status --json` to confirm. Wait for the reset (00:00 UTC) or query the local store instead — `news timeline`, `news search`, `screen`, `watchlist sentiment` all read locally.

troubleshoots.symptom: Commands return empty data without error
troubleshoots.fix: Likely the silent rate-limit case — older wrapper bug. Run `alphavantage-pp-cli doctor --json` to verify and force-surface the response shape.

troubleshoots.symptom: API key in `ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY` not picked up
troubleshoots.fix: The CLI reads `ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY` first; `ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY` is the alias. Either works; check `alphavantage-pp-cli doctor` for which one resolved.

troubleshoots.symptom: Premium-only endpoint returns nothing on free tier
troubleshoots.fix: REALTIME_OPTIONS, REALTIME_BULK_QUOTES, TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY require premium. Use `query function=PREMIUM_FUNCTION ...` to confirm AV's exact response.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI any time the workflow involves Alpha Vantage's news sentiment, top movers, earnings calendar, or technical indicators. The killer use case is sentiment-aware research: combine news sweep with the local FTS5 store and you can answer 'how did sentiment on NVDA evolve before its last earnings spike?' without re-burning quota. Pair with `/stock-deep-dive` and `/market-pulse` from the broader stock-toolkit; the `pulse us` command is purpose-built for the morning briefing.

recipes.title: Pre-earnings sentiment + transcript check
recipes.explanation: One command joins EARNINGS_CALENDAR, NEWS_SENTIMENT, and EARNINGS_CALL_TRANSCRIPT for a ticker. Use --select to narrow the response.

recipes.title: Top gainers minus low-sentiment names
recipes.explanation: Pre-market intel: today's gainers ranked alongside their local sentiment z-score. Drop names with negative sentiment z (potential reversal).

recipes.title: Watchlist sentiment delta since last scan
recipes.explanation: Reads named watchlist + recent ticker_sentiment history; reports per-ticker mean + change vs prior scan. Sunday-night ritual.

recipes.title: Compound screen: high-sentiment with upcoming earnings
recipes.explanation: Multi-predicate SQL across local tables. Surface high-conviction setups without external screeners.

recipes.title: Local FTS5 search for theme exposure
recipes.command: alphavantage-pp-cli news search "\\bdata center\\b OR cloud" --tickers NVDA,AMD --from 2026-04-01 --agent --select results.title,results.url,results.ticker_sentiment
recipes.explanation: Find articles mentioning a theme across pulled sentiment data. Regex word boundaries (\\b) match whole words. Zero API cost.
